en-US.desktop.languageSettings.intro: Settings that installed plugins provide for languages and frameworks. Choose one to open its settings.
en-US.desktop.languageSettings.failed: Could not read the settings pages plugins provide.
en-US.desktop.languageSettings.empty: No plugin provides language or framework settings yet. Install a language plugin and its settings appear here.
